    Draggable = true, Background = true, BlurBackground = true,
    AutoClose = true, PlayAnimations = true, BlockReExecute = true,
    AutoLoad = true, UUIDCheck = true,
}

local KEY_FILE = "Lunar_Key.txt"
local KEY_LENGTH = 36
local UUID_PAT = "^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$"

-- ═══ ANTI-DUPLICATE SYSTEM ═══
-- Remove any existing Lunar GUIs before creating new one
pcall(function()
    -- Kill old key system GUI
    local oldKS = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("LunarKeySystem")
    if oldKS then oldKS:Destroy() end
    
    -- Kill old blur effect
    local oldBlur = game:GetService("Lighting"):FindFirstChild("LunarBlur")
    if oldBlur then oldBlur:Destroy() end
    
    -- Also check PlayerGui as backup
    local playerGui = game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
        local oldPG = playerGui:FindFirstChild("LunarKeySystem")
        if oldPG then oldPG:Destroy() end
    end
end)

if Options.BlockReExecute then
    if getgenv().__LUNAR_KS_OPEN then 
        -- Reset the flag if GUI is gone
        if not game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("LunarKeySystem") then
            getgenv().__LUNAR_KS_OPEN = nil
        else
            return 
        end
    end
    getgenv().__LUNAR_KS_OPEN = true
end

do
    local existing = getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY
    if type(existing) == "string" and #existing > 0 then
        local valid = not Options.UUIDCheck or (existing:match(UUID_PAT) ~= nil)
        if valid then
            pcall(function()
                if writefile then writefile(KEY_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({key = existing})) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

cloneref = cloneref or function(...) return ... end
local service = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(self, name) rawset(self, name, cloneref(game:GetService(name))); return rawget(self, name) end})

local function Tween(o,p,d,s,dr) TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(d or 0.2,s or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,dr or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),p):Play() end
local function Spring(o,p,d) TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(d or 0.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),p):Play() end
local function New(cn,p) local o=Instance.new(cn); for k,v in pairs(p) do if k~="Parent" then o[k]=v end end; if p.Parent then o.Parent=p.Parent end; return o end
local function Round(o,r) local c=Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 6); c.Parent=o; return c end
local function Stroke(o,c,t,tr) local s=Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color=c or Themes.Border; s.Thickness=t or 1; s.Transparency=tr or 0; s.Parent=o; return s end
local function TouchCooldown(f,s) if not getgenv then return false end; if getgenv()[f] then return true end; getgenv()[f]=true; task.delay(s or 0.5,function() if getgenv then getgenv()[f]=nil end end); return false end
local function SaveKey(k) pcall(function() if not writefile then return end; writefile(KEY_FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode({key=k})) end) end
local function LoadKey() local s,r=pcall(function() if not (isfile and readfile) then return nil end; if not isfile(KEY_FILE) then return nil end; local raw=readfile(KEY_FILE); if not raw or #raw==0 then return nil end; local d=HttpService:JSONDecode(raw); return d and d.key or nil end); return s and r or nil end
local function GetHWID() local id=""; if gethwid then local s,v=pcall(gethwid); if s and v then id=tostring(v) end end; if id=="" then pcall(function() id=tostring(service.RbxAnalyticsService:GetClientId()) end) end; return id end

local function OpenDoorAnimation(cb)
    Window.Visible=true
    if not Options.PlayAnimations then
        LeftDoor.Visible=false; RightDoor.Visible=false; DoorLogo.Visible=false
        if Options.Background then BackgroundOverlay.BackgroundTransparency=0.62 end
        if BlurEffect then BlurEffect.Size=18 end
        if cb then cb() end; return
    end
    if Options.Background then Tween(BackgroundOverlay,{BackgroundTransparency=0.62},0.6) end
    if BlurEffect then Tween(BlurEffect,{Size=18},0.6) end
    Tween(DoorLogo,{ImageTransparency=1},0.5)
    task.delay(0.45,function()
        Tween(LeftDoor,{Position=UDim2.new(-0.5,0,0,0)},0.72,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        Tween(RightDoor,{Position=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)},0.72,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        task.delay(0.76,function() LeftDoor.Visible=false; RightDoor.Visible=false; DoorLogo.Visible=false; if cb then cb() end end)
    end)
end

local function CloseDoorAnimation(cb)
    if not Options.PlayAnimations then
        if Options.Background then BackgroundOverlay.BackgroundTransparency=1 end
        if BlurEffect then BlurEffect.Size=0 end
        ScreenGui:Destroy(); if cb then cb() end; return
    end
    LeftDoor.Visible=true; RightDoor.Visible=true; DoorLogo.Visible=true
    LeftDoor.Position=UDim2.new(-0.5,0,0,0); RightDoor.Position=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
    DoorLogo.ImageTransparency=1
    Tween(LeftDoor,{Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)},0.48,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    Tween(RightDoor,{Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,0)},0.48,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    task.delay(0.38,function() Tween(DoorLogo,{ImageTransparency=0},0.28) end)
    if Options.Background then task.delay(0.1,function() Tween(BackgroundOverlay,{BackgroundTransparency=1},0.38) end) end
    if BlurEffect then task.delay(0.1,function() Tween(BlurEffect,{Size=0},0.38) end) end
    task.delay(0.82,function() ScreenGui:Destroy(); if cb then cb() end end)
end

if Options.Draggable then
    local CameraInput
    pcall(function() CameraInput=require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"):WaitForChild("CameraModule"):WaitForChild("CameraInput")) end)
    local uiDragging,activeDragInput,dragStart,startPos=false,nil,nil,nil
    local function isClickInput(i) return i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch end
    local function clampWindow() local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize; local pos=Window.Position; return UDim2.new(0,math.clamp(pos.X.Offset,0,vp.X-WINDOW_WIDTH),0,math.clamp(pos.Y.Offset,0,vp.Y-WINDOW_HEIGHT)) end
    local function startDrag(i) if not isClickInput(i) or uiDragging then return end; uiDragging=true; activeDragInput=i; dragStart=i.Position; startPos=Window.Position; if CameraInput then pcall(function() CameraInput.setInputEnabled(false) end) end end
    Header.InputBegan:Connect(startDrag); Window.InputBegan:Connect(startDrag)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if not uiDragging then return end; if IS_MOBILE then if activeDragInput~=i or i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end else if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end end; local d=i.Position-dragStart; Window.Position=UDim2.new(0,startPos.X.Offset+d.X,0,startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y) end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if not uiDragging then return end; if IS_MOBILE then if activeDragInput~=i or i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end else if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end end; uiDragging=false; activeDragInput=nil; if CameraInput then pcall(function() CameraInput.setInputEnabled(true) end) end; Tween(Window,{Position=clampWindow()},0.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint) end)
end

local TabDefinitions={{label="Key",icon=Icons.Key},{label="User Info",icon=Icons.UserInfo},{label="Changelog",icon=Icons.Changelog}}
local TabButtons,TabPages,ActiveTab={},{},0

local function ActivateTab(idx)
    if idx==ActiveTab then return end
    local prev=ActiveTab; ActiveTab=idx
    Spring(TabPill,{Position=UDim2.new(0,(idx-1)*TAB_WIDTH+7,0.5,-12)},0.28)
    for i,td in ipairs(TabButtons) do local a=i==idx; Tween(td.Label,{TextColor3=a and Themes.Text or Themes.TextDim},0.16); Tween(td.Icon,{ImageColor3=a and Themes.Accent or Themes.TextDim},0.16) end
    if prev>0 then TabPages[prev].Visible=false end
    TabPages[idx].Visible=true
end

for i,def in ipairs(TabDefinitions) do
    local btn=New("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(0,TAB_WIDTH,1,0),Position=UDim2.new(0,(i-1)*TAB_WIDTH,0,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=5,Parent=TabBar})
    local ti=New("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=6,Parent=btn})
    New("UIListLayout",{FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,VerticalAlignment=Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,Padding=UDim.new(0,5),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=ti})
    local ic=New("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(0,13,0,13),BackgroundTransparency=1,Image=def.icon,ImageColor3=Themes.TextDim,LayoutOrder=1,ZIndex=6,Parent=ti})
    local lb=New("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(0,0,0,13),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=def.label,TextColor3=Themes.TextDim,Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,TextSize=11,LayoutOrder=2,ZIndex=6,Parent=ti})
    TabButtons[i]={Button=btn,Label=lb,Icon=ic}

    TabPages[i]=pg
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ActivateTab(i) end)
end

local processing=false

local function TryValidate(key)
    if not key or #key==0 then SetStatus("Enter a key first","warning"); ShakeInput(); return end
    if processing then return end
    if TouchCooldown("_Lunar_KS_LOCK",0.8) then return end
    processing=true
    RedeemLabel.Text="Checking..."; RedeemButton.Active=false
    Tween(RedeemButton,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(90,40,110)},0.15)
    Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Border,Transparency=0.4},0.15)
    local function reset() RedeemLabel.Text="Redeem Key"; RedeemLabel.TextColor3=Themes.Text; RedeemButton.Active=true; Tween(RedeemButton,{BackgroundColor3=Themes.AccentDark},0.15); if getgenv then getgenv()._Lunar_KS_LOCK=nil end; processing=false end
    if #key<KEY_LENGTH then SetStatus("Too short ("..(KEY_LENGTH-#key).." chars missing)","error"); Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Error,Transparency=0.3},0.15); ShakeInput(); task.delay(0.5,function() Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Border,Transparency=0.4},0.3) end); reset(); return end
    if #key>KEY_LENGTH then SetStatus("Too long ("..(#key-KEY_LENGTH).." extra chars)","error"); Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Error,Transparency=0.3},0.15); ShakeInput(); task.delay(0.5,function() Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Border,Transparency=0.4},0.3) end); reset(); return end
    if not key:match(UUID_PAT) then SetStatus("Wrong key format","error"); Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Error,Transparency=0.3},0.15); ShakeInput(); task.delay(0.5,function() Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Border,Transparency=0.4},0.3) end); reset(); return end
    SaveKey(key); getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY=key
    SetStatus("Key Accepted","success")
    Tween(InputCard,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,40,28)},0.2)
    Tween(InputStroke,{Color=Themes.Success,Transparency=0.2},0.2)
    Tween(RedeemButton,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,80,55)},0.2)
    RedeemLabel.Text="Redeemed ✓"; RedeemLabel.TextColor3=Themes.Success
    if getgenv then getgenv()._Lunar_KS_LOCK=nil end; processing=false
    if Options.AutoClose then task.delay(1.25,CloseDoorAnimation) end
end

local HUB_ACTIVE = true
local activeKeybinds = {}
_G.LunarHubKeybinds = {}

local function registerKeybind(techName, keyStr)
    for k, name in pairs(activeKeybinds) do
        if name == techName then activeKeybinds[k] = nil end
    end
    if keyStr == "None" or not keyStr or keyStr == "" then return true end
    local keyEnum = Enum.KeyCode[keyStr]
    if not keyEnum then return true end
    if activeKeybinds[keyEnum] and activeKeybinds[keyEnum] ~= techName then
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "⚠️ Duplicate Keybind!", Content = keyStr .. " is already bound to: " .. activeKeybinds[keyEnum], Duration = 4 })
        return false
    end
    activeKeybinds[keyEnum] = techName
    return true
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe or not HUB_ACTIVE then return end
    local techName = activeKeybinds[input.KeyCode]
    if techName and _G.LunarHubKeybinds[techName] then _G.LunarHubKeybinds[techName]() end
end)

local function isPlayerAlive()
    if not HUB_ACTIVE then return false end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function isEnemyAlive(enemyChar)
    if not enemyChar or not enemyChar.Parent then return false end
    local hum = enemyChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

    print("[Lunar Hub] Closed - All techs disabled")
end

local function getRoot(c) if not c then return nil end; return c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") end
local function getTorso(char) if not char then return nil end; return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getRoot(char) end

local function getNearestTarget(fromHRP)
    local nearest, nd = nil, math.huge
    for _, o in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if o ~= player and o.Character then
            local oh = o.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local oHum = o.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if oh and oHum and oHum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (fromHRP.Position - oh.Position).Magnitude
                if d < nd then nd = d; nearest = o.Character end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, fn in ipairs({"Live","Dummies","NPCs","Enemies","Training"}) do
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(fn)
        if folder then
            for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= player.Character then
                    local r2 = getRoot(m); local h2 = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if r2 and h2 and h2.Health > 0 then
                        local d = (fromHRP.Position - r2.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < nd then nd = d; nearest = m end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

local function getNearestRoot(fromHRP) local c = getNearestTarget(fromHRP); return c and getRoot(c) or nil end
local function forceJump(h) local c = player.Character; if not c then return end; local r = getRoot(c); if not r then return end; pcall(function() r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, h or 50, r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z) end) end

local function flip() if not cam then return end; local cf = cam.CFrame; local l = cf.LookVector; cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position, cf.Position + Vector3.new(-l.X, l.Y, -l.Z)) end

local function makeCArc(char2, dur, cArcSideRef)
    local hum2 = char2:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local r2 = char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum2 or not r2 then return end
    local active = true; local startTime = tick()
    local side = cArcSideRef[1]; cArcSideRef[1] = -cArcSideRef[1]
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not active or not HUB_ACTIVE then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; pcall(function() hum2.AutoRotate = true end); return end
        if not char2 or not r2 or not hum2 then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; return end
        hum2.AutoRotate = false
        local enemyChar = getNearestTarget(r2)
        if not enemyChar then return end
        local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemyChar); if not enemyRoot then return end
        local d = (r2.Position - enemyRoot.Position).Magnitude
        if d > 100 then return end
        local elapsed = tick() - startTime
        local t = math.clamp(elapsed / dur, 0, 1)
        local eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
        local arcAngle = math.rad(90) * eased * side
        local toEnemy = Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X - r2.Position.X, 0, enemyRoot.Position.Z - r2.Position.Z)
        if toEnemy.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
        local baseDir = toEnemy.Unit
        local cs, sn = math.cos(arcAngle), math.sin(arcAngle)
        local arcDir = Vector3.new(baseDir.X * cs - baseDir.Z * sn, 0, baseDir.X * sn + baseDir.Z * cs).Unit
        r2.CFrame = r2.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(r2.Position, r2.Position + arcDir), 0.5)
    end)
    task.delay(dur, function() active = false; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; pcall(function() hum2.AutoRotate = true end) end)
    hum2.Died:Connect(function() active = false; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end)
end

local function makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, dur, spd)
    local torso = getTorso(enemyChar)
    if not torso or not torso.Parent then return end
    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local t0 = tick(); local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not HUB_ACTIVE or not torso or not torso.Parent or tick() - t0 >= dur then
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            pcall(function() cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom end)
            return
        end
        if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
        local cp = cam.CFrame.Position
        local aim = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)
        local dir = aim - cp
        if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
        local cl = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local fd = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z); local fc = Vector3.new(cl.X, 0, cl.Z)
        if fd.Magnitude < 0.1 or fc.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
        local ty = math.atan2(fd.Unit.Z, fd.Unit.X); local cy = math.atan2(fc.Unit.Z, fc.Unit.X)
        local df = ty - cy
        if df > math.pi then df = df - 2*math.pi end
        if df < -math.pi then df = df + 2*math.pi end
        local ny = cy + df*spd; local pt = math.asin(math.clamp(cl.Y, -1, 1))
        pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cp, cp + Vector3.new(math.cos(ny)*math.cos(pt), math.sin(pt), math.sin(ny)*math.cos(pt))) end)
    end)
end

local function rotateCamBy(deg, duration)
    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local pitch, startYaw, roll = cam.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    local startT = os.clock(); local radDeg = math.rad(deg)
    repeat
        if not HUB_ACTIVE then break end
        if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
        local t = math.min((os.clock() - startT) / duration, 1)
        local yaw = startYaw + radDeg * t
        pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, roll) end)
        if t < 1 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
    until t >= 1
end

local function addTechUI(tab, techName, techDesc, techState, hookFn, defaultDelay, defaultJump)
    tab:Section({ Title = techName })
    local toggleElement = tab:Toggle({
        Title = techName, Desc = techDesc, Value = false,
        Callback = function(s) techState.on = s; if s and player.Character and HUB_ACTIVE then hookFn(player.Character) end end
    })
    _G.LunarHubToggles[techName] = toggleElement
    _G.LunarHubStates[techName] = techState
    tab:Slider({ Title = "Delay", Value = { Min = 0, Max = 3, Default = defaultDelay }, Step = 0.05, Callback = function(v) techState.delay = v end })
    tab:Slider({ Title = "Jump", Value = { Min = 30, Max = 100, Default = defaultJump }, Step = 1, Callback = function(v) techState.jump = v end })
    _G.LunarHubKeybinds[techName] = function()
        if not HUB_ACTIVE then return end
        local newState = not techState.on
        local worked = false
        pcall(function() toggleElement:SetValue(newState); worked = true end)
        if not worked then pcall(function() toggleElement:Set(newState); worked = true end) end
        if not worked then pcall(function() toggleElement.Value = newState; worked = true end) end
        if not worked then techState.on = newState; if newState and player.Character then hookFn(player.Character) end end
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = techName, Content = newState and "Enabled ✅" or "Disabled ❌", Duration = 2 })
    end
    tab:Keybind({
        Title = "Toggle Keybind", Desc = "Set a key to toggle this on/off", Value = "None",
        Callback = function(key) local keyStr = tostring(key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", ""); registerKeybind(techName, keyStr) end
    })
end

-- ═══ DRIPZ TECH ═══
do
    local dripz = { on=false, delay=0.3, jump=55, cooldown=2, busy=false, lastUse=0, cArcSide={1}, animConn=nil }
    local function dripz_do()
        if dripz.busy or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
        if tick() - dripz.lastUse < dripz.cooldown then return end
        dripz.lastUse = tick(); dripz.busy = true
        local char = player.Character; local hrp = char and getRoot(char)
        if not hrp then dripz.busy = false; return end
        local enemyChar = getNearestTarget(hrp)
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then dripz.busy = false; return end
        local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemyChar)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        task.delay(dripz.delay, function()
            if not dripz.on or not isPlayerAlive() then dripz.busy = false; return end
            if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then dripz.busy = false; return end
            local c2 = player.Character; local h2 = c2 and getRoot(c2); if not h2 then dripz.busy = false; return end
            if enemyRoot.Parent then h2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(h2.Position, Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X, h2.Position.Y, enemyRoot.Position.Z)) end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(dripz.jump)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then return end
                if enemyRoot.Parent then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, enemyRoot.Position) end) end
                rotateCamBy(90, 0.06); task.wait(0.02); rotateCamBy(-90, 0.06)
                if isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, 0.8, 0.15) end
            end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() local c3 = player.Character; if c3 and isPlayerAlive() then makeCArc(c3, 0.6, dripz.cArcSide) end end)
            task.delay(1.0, function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end; dripz.busy = false end)
        end)
    end
    local function dripz_hook(char)
        if dripz.animConn then dripz.animConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        dripz.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not dripz.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and UPPERCUT_IDS[a.AnimationId] then dripz_do() end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if dripz.on and HUB_ACTIVE then dripz_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "Dripz Tech (New)", "Sharp camera snap on uppercut", dripz, dripz_hook, 0.3, 55)
end

-- ═══ KING ═══
do
    local king = { on=false, delay=0.3, jump=55, animConn=nil, floatActive=false, floatConn=nil }
    local function king_stopFloat(hum) king.floatActive = false; if king.floatConn then king.floatConn:Disconnect(); king.floatConn=nil end; if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end end
    local function king_startFloat(char, dur)
        if king.floatActive then return end
        king.floatActive = true
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"); local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not r then king.floatActive = false; return end
        king.floatConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not king.floatActive or not king.on or not isPlayerAlive() then king_stopFloat(hum); return end
            if not char or not r or not hum then king_stopFloat(hum); return end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            local t = getNearestRoot(r)
            if t and t.Parent then
                local d = (r.Position - t.Position).Magnitude
                if d <= 100 then
                    local dir = Vector3.new(t.Position.X - r.Position.X, 0, t.Position.Z - r.Position.Z)
                    if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then r.CFrame = r.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(r.Position, r.Position + dir.Unit), 0.5) end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(dur or 0.5, function() king_stopFloat(hum) end)
        hum.Died:Connect(function() king_stopFloat(hum) end)
    end
    local function king_do()
        if not isPlayerAlive() then return end
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and getRoot(char); if not hrp then return end
        local enemy = getNearestTarget(hrp); if not isEnemyAlive(enemy) then return end
        task.delay(king.delay, function()
            if not king.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(king.jump)
            task.delay(0.2, function() if king.on then flip() end end)
            local c2 = player.Character
            task.delay(0.2, function() if king.on and c2 and isPlayerAlive() then king_startFloat(c2, 0.6) end end)
        end)
    end
    local function king_hook(char)
        if king.animConn then king.animConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        king.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not king.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and UPPERCUT_IDS[a.AnimationId] then king_do() end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if king.on and HUB_ACTIVE then king_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "King (New)", "Flip and float bypass on uppercut", king, king_hook, 0.3, 55)
end

-- ═══ KITTY V2 ═══
do
    local kitty = { on=false, delay=0.3, jump=55, cooldown=2, busy=false, lastUse=0, dashSide=-1, cArcSide={1}, animConn=nil }
    local function kitty_do()
        if kitty.busy or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
        if tick() - kitty.lastUse < kitty.cooldown then return end
        kitty.lastUse = tick(); kitty.busy = true
        local char = player.Character; local hrp = char and getRoot(char)
        if not hrp then kitty.busy = false; return end
        local enemyChar = getNearestTarget(hrp)
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then kitty.busy = false; return end
        local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemyChar)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        task.delay(kitty.delay, function()
            if not kitty.on or not isPlayerAlive() then kitty.busy = false; return end
            if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then kitty.busy = false; return end
            local c2 = player.Character; local h2 = c2 and getRoot(c2); if not h2 then kitty.busy = false; return end
            if enemyRoot.Parent then
                local toEnemy = Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X - h2.Position.X, 0, enemyRoot.Position.Z - h2.Position.Z)
                if toEnemy.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    local rad = math.rad(45 * kitty.dashSide)
                    local cs, sn = math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)
                    local zigDir = Vector3.new(toEnemy.Unit.X*cs - toEnemy.Unit.Z*sn, 0, toEnemy.Unit.X*sn + toEnemy.Unit.Z*cs).Unit
                    h2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(h2.Position, h2.Position + zigDir)
                    kitty.dashSide = -kitty.dashSide
                end
            end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(kitty.jump)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then return end
                if enemyRoot.Parent then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, enemyRoot.Position) end) end
                rotateCamBy(45, 0.04); task.wait(0.02); rotateCamBy(-90, 0.07)
                if isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, 0.8, 0.15) end
            end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() local c3 = player.Character; if c3 and isPlayerAlive() then makeCArc(c3, 0.6, kitty.cArcSide) end end)
            task.delay(1.0, function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end; kitty.busy = false end)
        end)
    end
    local function kitty_hook(char)
        if kitty.animConn then kitty.animConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        kitty.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not kitty.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and UPPERCUT_IDS[a.AnimationId] then kitty_do() end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if kitty.on and HUB_ACTIVE then kitty_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "Kitty V2 (New)", "Zigzag dash with asymmetric camera", kitty, kitty_hook, 0.3, 55)
end

        task.delay(twinnie.delay, function()
            if not twinnie.on or not isPlayerAlive() then twinnie.busy = false; return end
            if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then twinnie.busy = false; return end
            local c2 = player.Character; local h2 = c2 and getRoot(c2); if not h2 then twinnie.busy = false; return end
            if enemyRoot.Parent then h2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(h2.Position, Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X, h2.Position.Y, enemyRoot.Position.Z)) end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(twinnie.jump)
            task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.05); if isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, 0.8, 0.15) end end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() local c3 = player.Character; if c3 and isPlayerAlive() then makeCArc(c3, 0.6, twinnie.cArcSide) end end)
            task.delay(1.0, function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end; twinnie.busy = false end)
        end)
    end
    local function twinnie_hook(char)
        if twinnie.animConn then twinnie.animConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        twinnie.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not twinnie.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and UPPERCUT_IDS[a.AnimationId] then twinnie_do() end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if twinnie.on and HUB_ACTIVE then twinnie_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "Twinnie (New)", "Clean uppercut, no camera sweep", twinnie, twinnie_hook, 0.3, 55)
end

-- ═══ LOOPDASH ═══
do
    local FRONT_DASH_ANIM = "rbxassetid://10479335397"
    local loopdash = { on=false, delay=0.4, jump=55, dashing=false, spinSide=1, uppercutActive=false, mainConn=nil, frontCutConn=nil, activeCamLock=nil, savedCamType=nil }
    local LD_BYPASS = 0.8; local LD_ROT_SPD = 0.04; local LD_CAM_SPD = 0.13; local LD_CAM_DUR = 0.45; local LD_FRONT_CUT = 0.40

    local function ld_stopCamLock()
        if loopdash.activeCamLock then loopdash.activeCamLock:Disconnect(); loopdash.activeCamLock = nil end
        if cam then pcall(function() cam.CameraType = loopdash.savedCamType or Enum.CameraType.Custom end); loopdash.savedCamType = nil end
    end
    local function ld_camLock(enemy, dur, spd)
        if not enemy or not enemy.Parent then return end
        ld_stopCamLock()
        loopdash.savedCamType = cam.CameraType
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        local t0 = tick()
        loopdash.activeCamLock = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not HUB_ACTIVE or not enemy or not enemy.Parent or tick()-t0 >= dur then ld_stopCamLock(); return end
            if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
            local cp = cam.CFrame.Position; local aim = enemy.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0); local dir = aim - cp
            if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
            local cl = cam.CFrame.LookVector; local fd = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z); local fc = Vector3.new(cl.X, 0, cl.Z)
            if fd.Magnitude < 0.1 or fc.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
            local ty = math.atan2(fd.Unit.Z, fd.Unit.X); local cy = math.atan2(fc.Unit.Z, fc.Unit.X)
            local df = ty - cy
            if df > math.pi then df = df - 2*math.pi end
            if df < -math.pi then df = df + 2*math.pi end
            local ny = cy + df*spd; local pt = math.asin(math.clamp(cl.Y, -1, 1))
            pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cp, cp+Vector3.new(math.cos(ny)*math.cos(pt), math.sin(pt), math.sin(ny)*math.cos(pt))) end)
        end)
    end
    local function ld_rotateY(dir, deg) local r = math.rad(deg); return Vector3.new(dir.X*math.cos(r)-dir.Z*math.sin(r), 0, dir.X*math.sin(r)+dir.Z*math.cos(r)).Unit end
    local function ld_startRotateBypass(char, enemy, dur)
        if not char or not enemy then return end
        local active, elapsed = true, 0; local conn
        conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not active or not HUB_ACTIVE then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum or not enemy.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            elapsed = elapsed + dt; hum.AutoRotate = false
            local ef = Vector3.new(enemy.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, enemy.Position.Z)
            if (ef-hrp.Position).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local t = math.clamp(elapsed/dur, 0, 1)
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, ef), LD_ROT_SPD+(1-LD_ROT_SPD)*(t*t))
            end
        end)
        task.delay(dur, function()
            active = false; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrp and enemy and enemy.Parent then hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(enemy.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, enemy.Position.Z)) end
            task.wait(0.06); if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        end)
    end
    local function ld_killMoveme(hrp)
        if not hrp then return end
        task.delay(LD_FRONT_CUT, function()
            local mv = hrp:FindFirstChild("moveme"); if mv then mv:Destroy() end
            pcall(function() hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end)
        end)
    end
    local function ld_setupFrontCut(char)
        if loopdash.frontCutConn then loopdash.frontCutConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        loopdash.frontCutConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and a.AnimationId == FRONT_DASH_ANIM and loopdash.uppercutActive then
                local mv = hrp:FindFirstChild("moveme")
                if mv then ld_killMoveme(hrp)
                else
                    local found = false; local conn
                    conn = hrp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                        if found then return end
                        if child.Name == "moveme" and child:IsA("BodyVelocity") then
                            found = true; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; ld_killMoveme(hrp)
                        end
                    end)
                    task.delay(1, function() if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function ld_onAnim(track)
        if not loopdash.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
        local id = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
        if not id or not UPPERCUT_IDS[id] or loopdash.dashing then return end
        local char = player.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local enemy = getNearestRoot(root); if not enemy then return end
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemy.Parent) then return end
        loopdash.dashing = true; loopdash.uppercutActive = true
        task.delay(2, function() loopdash.uppercutActive = false end)
        task.spawn(function()
            if cam then
                local cl = cam.CFrame.LookVector; local cy = math.atan2(cl.Z, cl.X); local pt = math.asin(math.clamp(cl.Y, -1, 1))
                local t0 = tick(); local conn
                conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local el = tick()-t0; if el >= 0.30 or not HUB_ACTIVE then conn:Disconnect(); return end
                    local t = math.clamp(el/0.30, 0, 1)
                    local ny = cy + 1.20 * (1-math.pow(1-t,3))
                    pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(ny)*math.cos(pt), math.sin(pt), math.sin(ny)*math.cos(pt))) end)
                end)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(loopdash.delay, function()
            if not isPlayerAlive() then loopdash.dashing = false; return end
            local char2 = player.Character; local hrp = char2 and char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp and enemy.Parent then
                local toEnemy = Vector3.new(enemy.Position.X-hrp.Position.X, 0, enemy.Position.Z-hrp.Position.Z)
                if toEnemy.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position+ld_rotateY(toEnemy.Unit, 90*loopdash.spinSide))
                    loopdash.spinSide = -loopdash.spinSide
                end
            end
            autoPressQ()
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                if char2 and isPlayerAlive() then
                    ld_startRotateBypass(char2, enemy, LD_BYPASS)
                    task.delay(0.08, function() if enemy.Parent then ld_camLock(enemy, LD_CAM_DUR, LD_CAM_SPD) end end)
                end
            end)
            task.delay(LD_BYPASS+0.2, function() loopdash.dashing = false end)
        end)
    end
    local function loopdash_hook(char)
        if loopdash.mainConn then loopdash.mainConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        loopdash.dashing = false; loopdash.uppercutActive = false
        loopdash.mainConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(ld_onAnim); ld_setupFrontCut(char)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if loopdash.on and HUB_ACTIVE then loopdash_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "Loopdash (New)", "Alternating spin with tilted camera (no jump)", loopdash, loopdash_hook, 0.4, 55)
end

-- ═══ SUPA ═══
do
    local supa = { on=false, delay=0.26, jump=53, active=false, boostNext=false, dashDist=62, animConn=nil, descConn=nil }
    local function supa_modifyDash(v)
        if not supa.boostNext then return end
        if v.Name=="moveme" or v.Name=="dodgevelocity" or v.Name=="DashVelocity" then
            local vel = v.Velocity
            if vel.Magnitude > 0 then v.Velocity = vel.Unit * supa.dashDist * 3; supa.boostNext = false end
        end
    end
    local function supa_startBypass(char, dur)
        local active = true; local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"); local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not r then return end
        local conn
        conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not active or not HUB_ACTIVE then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end); return end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            local t = getNearestRoot(r)
            if t and t.Parent then
                local d = (r.Position - t.Position).Magnitude
                if d <= 100 then
                    local dir = Vector3.new(t.Position.X-r.Position.X, 0, t.Position.Z-r.Position.Z)
                    if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then r.CFrame = r.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(r.Position, r.Position + dir.Unit), 1) end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(dur, function() active = false; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end)
        hum.Died:Connect(function() active = false; if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end)
    end
    local function supa_do()
        if supa.active or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
        local hrp = getRoot(player.Character); local enemy = hrp and getNearestTarget(hrp)
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemy) then return end
        supa.active = true
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game)
            task.wait(0.18); VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.S, false, game); task.wait(0.08)
        end)
        task.delay(0.35, function() if isPlayerAlive() then forceJump(supa.jump) end end)
        task.delay(supa.delay, function()
            if not isPlayerAlive() then supa.active = false; return end
            supa.boostNext = true; autoPressQ()
            local c2 = player.Character; if c2 then supa_startBypass(c2, 0.36) end
        end)
        task.wait(1.0); supa.active = false
    end
    local function supa_hook(char)
        if supa.animConn then supa.animConn:Disconnect() end
        if supa.descConn then supa.descConn:Disconnect() end
        supa.descConn = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) if d:IsA("BodyVelocity") then supa_modifyDash(d) end end)
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BodyVelocity") then supa_modifyDash(d) end end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        supa.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not supa.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation
            if a and UPPERCUT_IDS[a.AnimationId] then task.spawn(supa_do) end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if supa.on and HUB_ACTIVE then supa_hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(TechsTab, "Supa (New)", "Backstep with dash boost and bypass", supa, supa_hook, 0.26, 53)
end
-- LETHAL TAB HEADER
LethalTab:Paragraph({ Title = "Lethal", Desc = "Lethal setups and finishers. Each triggers on lethal hit." })

local function addLethalTech(name, desc, doFn, defaultDelay, defaultJump)
    local state = { on=false, delay=defaultDelay, jump=defaultJump, cooldown=3, busy=false, lastUse=0, cArcSide={1}, animConn=nil }
    local function hook(char)
        if state.animConn then state.animConn:Disconnect() end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"); local anim = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        state.animConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            if not state.on or not isPlayerAlive() then return end
            local a = track and track.Animation; if not a then return end
            local num = tonumber(a.AnimationId:match("%d+"))
            if num == LETHAL_ANIM_ID then doFn(state) end
        end)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.25); if state.on and HUB_ACTIVE then hook(c) end end)
    addTechUI(LethalTab, name, desc, state, hook, defaultDelay, defaultJump)
end

-- ═══ BOOMY LETHAL (Z-Pattern) ═══
do
    local boomyLethal_dashSide = -1
    addLethalTech("Boomy Lethal (New)", "Zigzag dash with sweep on lethal", function(s)
        if s.busy then return end
        if tick() - s.lastUse < s.cooldown then return end
        s.lastUse = tick(); s.busy = true
        local char = player.Character; local hrp = char and getRoot(char)
        if not hrp then s.busy = false; return end
        local enemyChar = getNearestTarget(hrp)
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then s.busy = false; return end
        local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemyChar)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        task.delay(s.delay, function()
            if not s.on or not isPlayerAlive() then s.busy = false; return end
            if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then s.busy = false; return end
            local c2 = player.Character; local h2 = c2 and getRoot(c2); if not h2 then s.busy = false; return end
            if enemyRoot.Parent then
                local toEnemy = Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X-h2.Position.X, 0, enemyRoot.Position.Z-h2.Position.Z)
                if toEnemy.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    local rad = math.rad(45 * boomyLethal_dashSide)
                    local cs, sn = math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)
                    local zigDir = Vector3.new(toEnemy.Unit.X*cs - toEnemy.Unit.Z*sn, 0, toEnemy.Unit.X*sn + toEnemy.Unit.Z*cs).Unit
                    h2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(h2.Position, h2.Position + zigDir)
                    boomyLethal_dashSide = -boomyLethal_dashSide
                end
            end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(s.jump)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then return end
                if enemyRoot.Parent then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, enemyRoot.Position) end) end
                rotateCamBy(45, 0.04); task.wait(0.02); rotateCamBy(-90, 0.07)
                if isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, 0.8, 0.15) end
            end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() local c3 = player.Character; if c3 and isPlayerAlive() then makeCArc(c3, 0.6, s.cArcSide) end end)
            task.delay(1.0, function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end; s.busy = false end)
        end)
    end, 1.7, 55)
end

-- ═══ INSTANT LETHAL (90/-180) ═══
do
    addLethalTech("Instant Lethal (New)", "Quarter right then half left sweep", function(s)
        if s.busy then return end
        if tick() - s.lastUse < s.cooldown then return end
        s.lastUse = tick(); s.busy = true
        local char = player.Character; local hrp = char and getRoot(char)
        if not hrp then s.busy = false; return end
        local enemyChar = getNearestTarget(hrp)
        if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then s.busy = false; return end
        local enemyRoot = getRoot(enemyChar)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        task.delay(s.delay, function()
            if not s.on or not isPlayerAlive() then s.busy = false; return end
            if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then s.busy = false; return end
            local c2 = player.Character; local h2 = c2 and getRoot(c2); if not h2 then s.busy = false; return end
            if enemyRoot.Parent then h2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(h2.Position, Vector3.new(enemyRoot.Position.X, h2.Position.Y, enemyRoot.Position.Z)) end
            autoPressQ(); forceJump(s.jump)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if not isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then return end
                if enemyRoot.Parent then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, enemyRoot.Position) end) end
                rotateCamBy(90, 0.06); task.wait(0.02); rotateCamBy(-180, 0.10)
                if isEnemyAlive(enemyChar) then makeTorsoLock(enemyChar, 0.8, 0.15) end
            end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() local c3 = player.Character; if c3 and isPlayerAlive() then makeCArc(c3, 0.6, s.cArcSide) end end)
            task.delay(1.0, function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.AutoRotate = true end; s.busy = false end)
        end)
    end, 1.7, 55)
end

-- ═══ TAB DASH ═══
do
    UtilitiesTab:Section({ Title = "Tab Dash" })

    local LEFT_DASH_ANIM = "rbxassetid://10480796021"
    local RIGHT_DASH_ANIM = "rbxassetid://10480793962"

    local tabDash = {
        on=false, side="LEFT", lagTime=0.5, initialForce=60, initialTime=0.15,
        jumpForce=45, snapForce=40, snapTime=0.12, cooldown=1.3, animDur=0.6, onCooldown=false,
    }

    local function tabDash_lagFreeze(duration, animTrack, callback)
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        local frozenCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        local savedWS = hum.WalkSpeed; local savedJP = hum.JumpPower; local savedAR = hum.AutoRotate
        hum.WalkSpeed = 0; hum.JumpPower = 0; hum.JumpHeight = 0
        hum.AutoRotate = false; hum.PlatformStand = true
        if animTrack then animTrack:AdjustSpeed(0) end
        local active = true
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not active or not HUB_ACTIVE then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            local c = player.Character
            if not c then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if h then
                h.CFrame = frozenCFrame
                h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)
        task.delay(duration, function()
            active = false
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            if hum and hum.Parent then
                hum.WalkSpeed = savedWS; hum.JumpPower = savedJP
                hum.JumpHeight = 7.2; hum.AutoRotate = savedAR; hum.PlatformStand = false
            end
            if animTrack then animTrack:AdjustSpeed(1) end
            if callback then callback() end
        end)
    end

    local function tabDash_initialDash()
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local dir = tabDash.side == "LEFT" and -hrp.CFrame.RightVector or hrp.CFrame.RightVector
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * tabDash.initialForce, tabDash.jumpForce, dir.Z * tabDash.initialForce)
        local conn; local startT = tick()
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if tick() - startT >= tabDash.initialTime then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            local cv = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * tabDash.initialForce, cv.Y, dir.Z * tabDash.initialForce)
        end)
    end

    local function tabDash_snapFling()
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local dir = tabDash.side == "LEFT" and -hrp.CFrame.RightVector or hrp.CFrame.RightVector
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * tabDash.snapForce, 8, dir.Z * tabDash.snapForce)
        local conn; local startT = tick()
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if tick() - startT >= tabDash.snapTime then conn:Disconnect(); return end
            local cv = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * tabDash.snapForce, cv.Y, dir.Z * tabDash.snapForce)
        end)
    end

    local function tabDash_do()
        if tabDash.onCooldown or not isPlayerAlive() or not HUB_ACTIVE then return end
        tabDash.onCooldown = true
        local char = player.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        local dashTrack = nil
        if animator then
            local animId = tabDash.side == "LEFT" and LEFT_DASH_ANIM or RIGHT_DASH_ANIM
            local a = Instance.new("Animation")
            a.AnimationId = animId
            dashTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(a)
            dashTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            dashTrack:Play(0.1, 1, 1)
        end
        tabDash_initialDash()
        task.delay(tabDash.initialTime, function()
            tabDash_lagFreeze(tabDash.lagTime, dashTrack, function()
                tabDash_snapFling()
                task.delay(tabDash.animDur, function()
                    if dashTrack then dashTrack:Stop() end
                end)
            end)
        end)
        task.delay(tabDash.cooldown, function() tabDash.onCooldown = false end)
    end

    _G.LunarHubKeybinds["Tab Dash"] = tabDash_do

    UtilitiesTab:Toggle({
        Title = "Tab Dash", Desc = "Side dash with real lag freeze + minimal fling", Value = false,
        Callback = function(state) tabDash.on = state end
    })
    UtilitiesTab:Dropdown({
        Title = "Dash Side", Values = { "LEFT", "RIGHT" }, Value = "LEFT",
        Callback = function(v) tabDash.side = v end
    })
    UtilitiesTab:Slider({ Title = "Lag (Freeze Time)", Value = { Min = 0.1, Max = 2, Default = 0.5 }, Step = 0.05, Callback = function(v) tabDash.lagTime = v end })
    UtilitiesTab:Slider({ Title = "Fling Force", Value = { Min = 20, Max = 500, Default = 40 }, Step = 5, Callback = function(v) tabDash.snapForce = v end })
    UtilitiesTab:Slider({ Title = "Jump Force", Value = { Min = 20, Max = 100, Default = 45 }, Step = 1, Callback = function(v) tabDash.jumpForce = v end })
    UtilitiesTab:Slider({ Title = "Cooldown", Value = { Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = 1.3 }, Step = 0.1, Callback = function(v) tabDash.cooldown = v end })
    UtilitiesTab:Keybind({
        Title = "Tab Dash Keybind", Desc = "Set a key to trigger tab dash", Value = "E",
        Callback = function(key)
            local keyStr = tostring(key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")
            for k, name in pairs(activeKeybinds) do
                if name == "Tab Dash" then activeKeybinds[k] = nil end
            end
            if keyStr ~= "None" and keyStr ~= "" then
                local keyEnum = Enum.KeyCode[keyStr]
                if keyEnum then
                    if activeKeybinds[keyEnum] and activeKeybinds[keyEnum] ~= "Tab Dash" then
                        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "⚠️ Duplicate Keybind!", Content = keyStr .. " is already bound to: " .. activeKeybinds[keyEnum], Duration = 4 })
                    else
                        activeKeybinds[keyEnum] = "Tab Dash"
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    })
end

TeleportTab:Paragraph({ Title = "Teleport", Desc = "Teleport to players or set your own spots." })
do
    local selectedPlayer = nil
    local function getPlayerList() local l = {}; for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= player then table.insert(l, p.Name) end end; return l end
    local playerDropdown = TeleportTab:Dropdown({ Title = "Select Player", Values = getPlayerList(), Value = "", Callback = function(n) selectedPlayer = n end })
    TeleportTab:Button({ Title = "🔄 Refresh Player List", Callback = function() pcall(function() playerDropdown:Refresh(getPlayerList()) end) end })
    TeleportTab:Button({ Title = "Teleport to Selected Player", Callback = function()
        if not selectedPlayer then return end
        local t = Players:FindFirstChild(selectedPlayer); if not t or not t.Character then return end
        local m = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tr = t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if m and tr then m.CFrame = tr.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3) end
    end })
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(1); pcall(function() playerDropdown:Refresh(getPlayerList()) end) end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.wait(1); pcall(function() playerDropdown:Refresh(getPlayerList()) end) end)
end

-- ═══ VISUALS TAB ═══
VisualsTab:Paragraph({ Title = "Visuals", Desc = "Highlight players and change how the world looks." })

do
    VisualsTab:Section({ Title = "Counter ESP" })
    local counterEspHighlights = {}
    local counterEspEnabled = false
    local function addCounterHL(c)
        if counterEspHighlights[c] then return end
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight"); h.Name = "CounterESP_Highlight"
        h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 102, 204); h.FillTransparency = 0.5
        h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; h.Adornee = c; h.Parent = c
        counterEspHighlights[c] = h
    end
    local function removeCounterHL(c) if counterEspHighlights[c] then counterEspHighlights[c]:Destroy(); counterEspHighlights[c] = nil end end
    local function hasCounter(c) for _, a in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("Accessory") and a.Name == "Counter" then return true end end; return false end
    local function watchChar(c)
        if hasCounter(c) then addCounterHL(c) end
        c.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch) if counterEspEnabled and ch:IsA("Accessory") and ch.Name == "Counter" then addCounterHL(c) end end)
        c.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(ch) if ch:IsA("Accessory") and ch.Name == "Counter" then removeCounterHL(c) end end)
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= player then p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) if counterEspEnabled then watchChar(c) end end) end end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) if p ~= player then p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) if counterEspEnabled then watchChar(c) end end) end end)
    VisualsTab:Toggle({ Title = "Counter ESP", Desc = "Highlights players with Counter equipped", Value = false, Callback = function(s)
        counterEspEnabled = s
        if s then for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= player and p.Character then watchChar(p.Character) end end
        else for c in pairs(counterEspHighlights) do removeCounterHL(c) end end
    end })
end

VisualsTab:Section({ Title = "Player ESP" })
VisualsTab:Toggle({ Title = "ESP Highlight", Desc = "Highlights all players in red", Value = false, Callback = function(s)
    for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= player and v.Character then
            if s then
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight"); h.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
                h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); h.FillTransparency = 0.5
                h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; h.Parent = v.Character
            else local h = v.Character:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight"); if h then h:Destroy() end end
        end
    end
end })
